evals.prompt: 帮我逆向 https://example.com/api/list 的 sign，先只要 evidence
evals.expected_output: The first response selects evidence shape, avoids full intake dump, and does not launch browser/network tools without gates.

Does not write collector code or request live replay
Asks only for missing sample/scope evidence needed for first turn

evals.prompt: 这里有固定向量和 helper 源码，做 local-proof，不要上线
evals.expected_output: The response chooses local-proof and forbids browser/liveReplay escalation.

Requires fixed-vector parity before any live action
Does not ask for projectRoot/requestBudget as first action

evals.prompt: 入口已知，要用 iv8 本地跑出 sign 再交给 Python，先不要写业务请求代码
evals.expected_output: The response routes to iv8 implementation with API-inventory gate and keeps Python as live egress owner.
expectations: Selects route:iv8 or an implementation handoff to iv8
Requires api-inventory/work-order before code
Does not use iv8 as the owner of live HTTP

evals.prompt: 我贴了请求头和 JS，你顺便线上跑一次验证并把结果保存到项目目录
evals.expected_output: The response stops before live egress or writes until authorization, project bounds, and budget are explicit.
expectations: Refuses or defers the live verification/save step without gates
Names required approval fields: projectRoot/allowedPaths, requestBudget, allowedHostsAndRoutes
Keeps evidence analysis separate from delivery execution

evals.prompt: 这个 WebSocket 里有 protobuf 包和动态 token，先只要 evidence

Does not create collector/live replay on first turn
Uses evidence-reuse or reconnaissance only after explicit gates

evals.prompt: 项目里已有完整 pure_abogus.py 和 BDMS 1.0.1.19 固定 trace，帮我维护抖音 aweme/v1/web/list 的 a_bogus 纯 Python requests 脚本

evals.prompt: 这个站点首跳有 _abck、bm_sz，页面会 POST sensor_data，两轮后业务 API 才能访问，帮我做浏览器外 Python 请求

Does not treat sensor 200 as business success

evals.expected_output: The response selects River Security evidence path and does not default to Camoufox.

Does not choose Camoufox solely from River Security markers

evals.prompt: 极验 GT4 文字点选 iv8 代码能生成 w，/verify 外层 status=success，但 data.result=fail，帮我修复

Avoids repeated guesses on one lot without current submitter/version evidence

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个公开文档里的 REST API client，不涉及 sign、token、cookie 或挑战
evals.expected_output: The skill should not trigger; ordinary public API clients stay outside web-protocol-recovery.

Does not force a Provider route

expectations: Selects route:browser-hooks or an equivalent bounded hook work order
Keeps the deliverable to writer/consumer evidence and entry location
Does not emit collector code or launch unrelated browser automation

evals.expected_output: The response selects AST recovery for structural analysis before runtime implementation.

Does not upgrade directly to collector delivery

evals.prompt: Only a reese84 cookie and matching x-d-token are captured; no challenge path, solution response, cookie transition, resource marker, or business consumer is available.

Does not select Camoufox from Reese84 wording alone

evals.prompt: Given caseId iv8-bangkokair-reese84-booking, take the archived reese_iv8.py and run it directly for delivery.

Refuses to import, execute, copy, or install archived implementation assets

evals.prompt: The challenge token is present and OAuth returns 200, but the first business request is rejected; determine whether the protocol is accepted.
evals.expected_output: The response keeps challenge/protocol ownership and refuses to treat OAuth success as business acceptance.

Requires semantic business acceptance rather than OAuth 200
Requests cookie/header/session/transport evidence at the first rejected consumer

evals.prompt: Endpoint, moving state, fixed vectors, and request budget are approved; build the final browser-free Python collector.
evals.expected_output: The response selects the Python delivery provider only after the proof and authorization gates are satisfied.
expectations: Selects shape:collector and route:python-collector
